title: REPAC Viewer Manifest
description: Schema for the root manifest governing a generated REPAC viewer export package.

exportContractVersion.description: Version of VIEWER-EXPORT-CONTRACT.md governing this export.

viewerDataVersion.description: Version of the generated viewer data package.

ontologyRelease.description: Ontology release identifier associated with the export.

ontologyLayerPath.description: Repository path to the ontology layer used as source.

aggregateOntologyPath.description: Optional repository path to the aggregate ontology used for validation.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp indicating when the export package was generated.

sourceOfTruth.description: Authoritative files and directories used to generate the viewer data.

supersets.description: Canonical REPAC superset slugs included in the export.

notes.description: Optional build notes for human inspection.
